final_text:
THINK: Brief was a Thai-language, single-file Google landing page fusing Editorial Minimalism × Modern Swiss × Liquid Glass × Visible Grid. The first draft passed the aesthetic but failed the ship gate on three deliverables: English copy for a Thai brief, 3 font families (limit 2), and no dark mode / OG image. I rewrote with Thai copy on two Thai-capable fonts (Trirong serif + Prompt sans), added a full `prefers-color-scheme: dark` palette and `og:image`, then the 390px check caught an 11px overflow — traced to the search `<input>`'s intrinsic width inflating the grid track via `min-width:auto`, fixed with `min-width:0` on the grid items. Re-ran clean.

**Deliverable:** `D:\qbench-work\A-ccguide-r1\google-landing.html` — one self-contained file (inline CSS + JS, Google Fonts via CDN).

## Brief coverage

| the brief names | element(s) that deliver it |
|---|---|
| Editorial Minimalism | Trirong serif display, numbered sections N°01–06, manifesto pull-statement, luxury white space, editorial lede |
| Modern Swiss | 12-col grid, 8pt spacing, Prompt sans, Swiss red `#D62839` accent, mono-style labels, asymmetric 7/5 featured card (intentional grid-break) |
| Liquid Glass | `.glass` (`backdrop-filter: blur`) on nav, hero search bar, 8 product cards, closing panel — blurs the grid lines behind them |
| Visible Grid | `.grid-frame` (12 faint column lines, full page) + `.col-ruler` (01–12 ruler) |
| dark mode | `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` inverts the whole palette (paper→warm near-black, red→`#FF5A66`, glass→translucent light) |
| Open Graph tags | `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image` |
| the brief's language (Thai) | all copy is Thai; Trirong + Prompt are Thai-capable (the original Latin fonts had no Thai glyphs) |
